name: shipcloud
description: Shipcloud is a shipping service provider for creating shipping labels as well as tracking shipments.

events.d: Retrieve all carriers available for your account.
Retrieve a paginated list of shipments with filters (carrier, status, type, date) and optional response field selection.
Retrieve the full details of a specific shipment by its ID, including carrier info, addresses, packages, tracking events, and label URL.
Retrieve a list of all trackers in your shipcloud account, including their carrier tracking numbers, statuses, and tracking events.
Retrieve tracker details by providing a tracker ID.
